0.0: You must be the one that #p2101011#, #p2101003#, and #p2101002# have been talking about. You've done well passing their tests. Now, let me tell you a story about #m260000000#.
0.1: #m260000000# was founded by wanderers in Nihal Desert. Now, the place may not look like much, but thanks to #t4011008# and the oasis, Ariant has become a center of commerce. #t4011008# is an ore found only in the desert. Since it's very valuable, it's the main source of wealth for #m260000000#.
0.2: But look around. Where has that wealth gone? #m260000000# is falling apart around us, and there's only one reason: the queen. This so-called fairy queen is frivolous and heartless. Our taxes go to pay for her jewels while #m260000000# suffers! Do you understand now the pain of #m260000000#?

yes.0: Then wander through #m260000000# some more and open your eyes. See what this place is really like! If you are sure you want to be a part of the Sand Bandits, let me know.

no.0: You still don't get it? Then I'll tell you the story again.

1.0: Are you ready to fight the queen as a member of the Sand Bandits, for the sake of #m260000000#?

yes.0: Then from here on out, I proudly accept you as an official member of the Sand Bandits. Go now to meet the brothers and sister who stand by your side.

QuestInfo.name: The True Identity of Sand Bandits
QuestInfo.0: You have passed all the tests, and you have heard from each member of the Sand Bandits that they accept you. Now you should find their secret headquarters.
QuestInfo.1: The captain of the Sand Bandits, #b#p2101010##k, tells you a story about the queen of #m260000000#. He then requests that you look around #m260000000# and decide if you really want to join the Sand Bandits.
QuestInfo.2: You are finally member of the Sand Bandits, thanks to #p2101010#. As a member, your job is to do your best for the people of #m260000000#.
